---
pagetitle: "Raphael Ludwig"
page-layout: custom
toc: false
title-block-banner: false
include-before-body: assets/html/particles-embed.html
include-after-body: assets/html/particles-scripts.html
listing:
  # Two listings, one per language, because `listing` lives in frontmatter and
  # frontmatter is not profile-aware. BOTH render into every page — the wrong one
  # is hidden with CSS further down, not removed. (blog/index.qmd solves the same
  # problem with a separate file instead, because it has a category filter widget
  # whose counts would aggregate across both listings; this page has none.)
  #
  # ⚠ Adding `categories: true` to these listings means this page has to be split
  # into two files too — the counts would silently double, with no error.
  #
  # Both are "everything except the other language's posts". Today no post carries
  # either marker, so both listings show the two Portuguese posts — which is the
  # intent until the translations exist. As posts get translated:
  #   - a PT post whose EN twin now exists gets `en-version: true` → drops out of EN
  #   - a new EN post gets `pt-version: true` → drops out of PT
  - id: home-listing-en
    # Numeric prefix = a post. Excluding index.qmd by name is not enough: the
    # blog index has a language twin (blog/index-pt.qmd) that would match too.
    contents: "blog/[0-9]*.qmd"
    exclude:
      en-version: true
    type: grid
    grid-columns: 1
    sort: "date desc"
    max-items: 5
    fields: [title, description, date, categories]
  - id: home-listing-pt
    # Numeric prefix = a post. Excluding index.qmd by name is not enough: the
    # blog index has a language twin (blog/index-pt.qmd) that would match too.
    contents: "blog/[0-9]*.qmd"
    exclude:
      pt-version: true
    type: grid
    grid-columns: 1
    sort: "date desc"
    max-items: 5
    fields: [title, description, date, categories]
---
